items.prompt:
Do not change the face. A photograph of a woman sitting in a vintage cream-colored car, leaning relaxed against the fully open side window. She rests her head on her folded arms, one arm hanging loosely outside, and her gaze is calmly directed straight at the lens. Shot from the car window, the composition is tight and cinematic, with the car taking up most of the frame and serving as a natural frame for the model. The main focus is on the woman’s face and cowboy hat.

The woman’s hair is left loose, voluminous, and softly styled with a round brush, with the ends curled inward.

Natural makeup with a light matte finish, satin eyeshadow in soft taupe (RGB 167, 151, 139), thin dark brown eyeliner along the lash line, voluminous mascara, a subtle satin highlight in the inner corners of the eyes, and a nude lipstick in muted beige rose (RGB 196, 162, 150). The skin appears perfectly even and matte with a light tan.

The manicure is medium-length, soft oval-shaped, and has a warm, milky soft ivory (RGB 244, 239, 232) polish with a glossy finish.

On her head is a woven cowboy hat in a natural straw brown (RGB 158, 120, 78) shade, made of natural straw with a distinctly textured matte finish.

The outfit is hidden behind the car. The look is completed with small hoop earrings made of polished gold metal.

The car is a vintage cream sedan with a warm cream paint (RGB 231, 220, 198), glossy paint, chrome moldings, and a metal roof rack.

The shoot takes place in a warm, rural area. The interior of the classic car is visible, and a softly blurred natural landscape is barely discernible outside the window. The atmosphere conveys the tranquility, freedom of the road, and the aesthetics of a summer road trip.

The primary light source is natural sunlight during golden hour. The sun is positioned slightly to the left of the model, creating a soft backlight with a warm golden halo. The shadows are soft and deep, and the contrast is moderate.

Shot with a 50mm equivalent lens. The textures of skin, straw, painted metal, fabric, and hair are captured in exquisite detail. Professional photoshoot style.
items.title: 海滨长廊金色人像
